description: Find Quest Diagnostics patient service centers (blood-draw sites) near a 5-digit US ZIP code where a JustLabs order can be collected: site code, address, distance, hours, walk-ins and a booking link, optionally with the next open appointment times. Send only a ZIP code — never a street address, name or contact details. The response names the states where JustLabs does not accept orders.

title: Find Draw Sites
